comments.why: Entertaining lectures on nuclear weapons basics by Matthew Bunn
comments.text: For anyone interested in the basics of nuclear weapons, I highly recommend the "Nuclear 101: How Nuclear Bombs Work" lectures by Matthew Bunn, a man heavily involved in nuclear arms control. His lectures are always highly entertaining, a real pleasure to watch. comments.text: In context, here is a great video from the Belfer center on nuclear bomb making and what are the hard parts [0].
